5. **Use of Information**: This part restricts how the Receiving Party can use the confidential information, typically limiting it to the purposes specified in the agreement.

6. **Return or Destruction of Information**: This clause requires the Receiving Party to return or destroy all copies of the confidential information upon request or at the end of the agreement term.

8. **Limitation of Liability**: This section limits the liability of the parties in case of breach or other claims.

9. **Governing Law and Jurisdiction**: This clause specifies which laws will govern the agreement and where any disputes will be resolved.
